content.short: Graduate Blockchain Society at McCombs connects UT students with blockchain and Web3 education through sessions and hands-on projects.
content.description: Graduate Blockchain Society at McCombs is a University of Texas student organization dedicated to blockchain technology and Web3 education for University of Texas students. The group hosts sessions led by experienced professors to explain the practical challenges of building blockchain applications and to share insights from current research. Members and prospective participants can join to work on real-world blockchain projects, and the organization runs collaborative programs and campaigns to encourage participation and advance Web3.
